Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Graham for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (the Downtown Graham Ice Skating Rink) through December 13, with the 65th Annual Graham Christmas Parade (December 5) and the free synthetic ice rink along the way, plus Cookies with Santa, a gingerbread program, Christmas crafts week and an ugly sweater party already listed. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Graham

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Graham
